title: Modern CI/CD: GitHub Actions & GitLab CI
description: Automate workflows with GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, including reusable workflows, secrets management, and deployment strategies.
longDescription: This module explores modern CI/CD platforms. You'll learn to automate builds, tests, and deployments using GitHub Actions workflows and GitLab CI/CD pipelines, compare the two platforms, and understand best practices for secrets management and deployment strategies.
whatYouLearn: Build and trigger workflows with GitHub Actions
Compare CI/CD platforms and apply deployment strategies
